analysis.title: Russell 2k Futures: Another Retail Favorite?
key_insights: On Nov 11, Russell 2k 3-month funding jumped 13bps versus a median 1-day change of 6bps over the past year, and Russell 2k's funding discount to S&P narrowed. GS reads this as probable demand for leveraged exposure.

GS's Retail Favorites basket gained 5% on Nov 11. Based on cash basket performance, the Other and Non-Reportable cohorts potentially initiated longs in Russell 2k futures. Historically, changes in their gross longs were positively correlated with this basket.
Other and Non-Reportable cohorts were a combined 7% of Russell 2k futures open interest as of the Nov 3 Commitment of Traders update, so their buying is a small part of the market.

An extended rate hiking cycle is an imminent threat. Earlier in 2026, Asset Manager gross longs in Russell 2k futures were strongly positively correlated to SOFR: Asset Managers liquidated longs when the market priced more or higher-for-longer rates. The relationship has deteriorated recently.
risk_factors: An extended rate hiking cycle could lead Asset Managers to liquidate Russell 2k futures longs.
The retail-driven positioning is a small share of open interest (7%), so it may not sustain a broader move.

vol_and_positioning: Russell 2k 3-month funding rose 13bps on Nov 11 versus a median 1-day move of 6bps over the past year, and the funding discount to S&P narrowed, pointing to demand for leveraged long exposure.
Other and Non-Reportable gross longs in Russell 2k futures were a combined 7% of open interest as of the Nov 3 CFTC Commitment of Traders data.
Asset Manager Russell 2k gross longs tracked SOFR-implied rates earlier in 2026 (liquidation when the market priced higher-for-longer rates), though the correlation has weakened recently.

tension_points.bull_case: Funding richened 13bps and the Retail Favorites basket gained 5%, suggesting Other and Non-Reportable cohorts potentially initiated Russell 2k futures longs, with the funding discount to S&P narrowing.
tension_points.bear_case: These cohorts are only 7% of open interest, and an extended rate hiking cycle is an imminent threat, since Asset Managers liquidated longs when the market priced higher-for-longer rates earlier in 2026.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Asset Manager gross longs resuming their correlation to SOFR as the market prices more or higher-for-longer rates.

theme_stances.key_argument: Funding and the Retail Favorites basket point to probable new longs from small cohorts, but they are a small share of open interest and rate hikes remain a threat.
